info.name: Pioneer DJ XDJ-RR
info.author: openDJ
info.description: openDJ mapping for the XDJ-RR all-in-one in PC control (MIDI) mode: two decks, the mixer, Beat FX and Sound Color FX, hot cue, pad FX, beat loop and beat jump pads. Beta: written from the XDJ-RR's MIDI messages as rekordbox maps them, not yet tried on the hardware.
